title: Anthropic Expands Access to Latest AI Models for Cyber Firms
summary: Anthropic is widening access to its most advanced AI models for a select group of cybersecurity organizations. They will test the models' cyber capabilities in collaboration with the US government.

title: Billions Pour Into OpenAI, DeepSeek Ahead of IPOs
summary: OpenAI is in talks with multiple investors to raise at least $30 billion at a valuation of about $1.4 trillion, while DeepSeek is close to securing at least $12 billion ahead of its own IPO next year.

title: Deeply Distressed US Loans Rise to Highest Level Since Pandemic, JPMorgan Says
summary: The deeply distressed tail of the US leveraged loan market has reached its highest level since the pandemic, according to JPMorgan, with technology the biggest sector under pressure.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic Lead Consumer AI Spending: A16z
summary: A16z's Olivia Moore says consumer AI adoption is growing but fewer than 5% of consumers pay for any AI product. OpenAI and Anthropic dominate spending, with some power users paying up to $1,000 a month.

title: Anthropic, OpenAI Can Both Win AI Race: T. Rowe Price
summary: T. Rowe Price's Emma Norchet says Anthropic is entering an 'act two', moving beyond coding to become an AI layer where businesses execute entire workflows. The firm holds multi-billion-dollar positions in both Anthropic and OpenAI and sees room for both to win.

title: Bender: AI’s ‘Existential’ Risk Is ‘Fake’
summary: University of Washington professor Emily Bender argues the AI safety debate is too focused on hypothetical existential threats. She says it overlooks present harms such as environmental costs, worker disruption, surveillance and misinformation.

title: Jamie Dimon Warns on AI's Growing Cyber Threat
summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warns about AI's growing cyber threat in an exclusive interview, alongside comments on rising debt and dealmaking. Ray Dalio is also sounding the alarm on bonds.

title: México crecerá por debajo del promedio de América Latina en 2026, dice el Banco Mundial
summary: The World Bank expects Mexico to grow below the Latin American average in 2026, with El Salvador and Paraguay among the faster-growing economies.

title: El peso mexicano se recupera y regresa a 17.95 por dólar; petróleo y bonos dan un respiro
summary: El peso mexicano se recupera y regresa a 17.95 por dólar, con respiro por la caída del petróleo y los bonos, según Expansión.

title: Palmer Luckey’s Erebor surges to more than $7bn in deposits since launch
summary: Palmer Luckey's Erebor, a start-up bank for the technology industry, has surged past $7bn in deposits since launch, seeking to fill the void left by Silicon Valley Bank's collapse.

title: AI to See Massive Adoption 'Unseen' in Previous Tech Cycles, Says Neostellar Principal
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence says the US lead over China in AI performance has narrowed to a record low as labs such as DeepSeek gain ground. Neostellar's Willy Lee gives a VC view on AI adoption.

title: JPMorgan's Dimon Weighs In on AI Boom, Bond Selloff and UK Banks
summary: Jamie Dimon discusses the issues behind financing the AI boom, the global bond selloff and the state of UK banks at JPMorgan's Tech Stars Conference in London.

title: The bond market turns on France
summary: France is being hit by a pre-election debt sell-off in the bond market, and many fear it could shake the Eurozone.

title: Banco Mundial: América Latina reduce ritmo de crecimiento a 2.2% en 2026
summary: The World Bank projects Latin America and the Caribbean will slow to 2.2% growth in 2026 from 2.4% last year. El Salvador, Paraguay and Argentina lead the region.

title: Uber to Buy EzCater for $2.3 Billion in Enterprise Push
summary: Uber is buying catering platform ezCater for $2.3 billion in cash, a deal to push Uber Eats toward a more corporate clientele.

title: Nuestra próxima tasa de interés podría decidirla un algoritmo
summary: Opinion column in Expansión on how Mexico's next interest rate could be decided by an algorithm, touching on AI's role in monetary policy and rate-setting.

title: El efectivo vuelve invisible a las pymes y les cierra la puerta al crédito
summary: Expansión analyzes how reliance on cash keeps Mexican SMEs invisible to lenders and closes the door to credit, linking digital payments to access to financing.

title: Alto costo del espectro condiciona todavía el despliegue de redes en México: Daniel Hajj
summary: El costo del espectro en México sigue por encima del promedio latinoamericano y condiciona el despliegue de redes, advirtió Daniel Hajj, director general de América Móvil, en el México Digital Summit.

title: Banco de México destaca respaldo del FMI y descarta alarma por depreciación del peso
summary: Banco de México highlights IMF support and downplays alarm over the peso's depreciation, in an Expansión report on inflation expectations through 2028.

title: Querétaro, Cancún y Los Cabos crecen, pero falta vivienda para sus trabajadores
summary: Expansión reports that Querétaro, Cancún and Los Cabos keep growing economically, but housing for their workers is lacking.

title: GPU Financing Filters Into ABS With Stonebriar, Wingspire Deals
summary: Demand for capital to fund AI investment is reaching a little-watched corner of the ABS market: bonds backed by equipment loans and leases. GPU financing deals from Stonebriar and Wingspire are the latest examples.

title: De Nubank a Petrobras: acciones en Brasil se disparan y el Ibovespa cierra en máximo histórico
summary: Las acciones brasileñas extendieron el avance posterior a las elecciones y el Ibovespa cerró en récord, con alzas de más de 20% en varios líderes como Petrobras y Nubank.

title: Mora y el “cambio de tendencia” en el crédito que ve el CEO de Supervielle para el cierre de 2026
summary: El CEO de Banco Supervielle, Gustavo Manríquez, prevé que los últimos meses de 2026 muestren mejoras en el crédito y la morosidad en Argentina, con mayor oferta de crédito desde septiembre.
